title: CI now also runs on the merge queue
summary: A three-line change to the CI workflow: the `merge_group` event is added to the `on:` triggers of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, alongside the existing `pull_request` and `push` triggers. Nothing about the jobs, steps or gates inside the workflow changes — the same required checks that run on a pull request now also run on the merge-queue branch, which is the only place a workflow listening for `merge_group` is executed. The blast radius is therefore the trigger surface of the pipeline rather than its internals: the merge queue gains a producer of CI runs, and the existing pull-request and main-branch paths are untouched.
